description: E001 has no numeric attendance estimate in the opened event account. Qualitative “massively” wording in a separate search-only result cannot establish 50 people.
required_followup: Seek a contemporaneous count or a clearly attributed and sufficiently specific crowd estimate; do not pool other towns or infer attendance from barricades or wording.

description: The Kissidougou article gives no route, physical perimeter, or end of the gathering, and later recurrence is unresolved.
required_followup: Check dated same-event and follow-up reporting for the physical end and separate subsequent gatherings; leave end unknown until supported.

description: The report names EDG and SEG offices as intended targets. EDG’s institutional page reproduces a 2019 public-company decree, but neither service responsibility in Kissidougou nor SEG’s legal status was verified.
required_followup: Verify the utilities’ ownership and local service responsibility as of February 2021, and determine whether the reported demand was directed at state policy or a public authority.

description: Four additional Kissidougou result cards are search-only; their written origins, syndication and independent reporting status have not been established.
required_followup: Review the exact articles if access gates pass; compare bylines, credits and written dispatch attribution before counting any account as independent.

description: The Faranah body-read report gives no protester count. Nearly ten barriers and more than 100 delayed vehicles are not attendance measures.
required_followup: Seek a direct attendance estimate or other specific crowd-size evidence; keep the 50-person threshold pending.

description: E002 concerns electricity service, but the event report does not name the utility. The EDG institutional page does not prove EDG’s regional operations or responsibility for this particular outage.
required_followup: Verify which entity operated the affected Faranah service in February 2021 and whether the demand was directed to the Guinean state or its policy.

description: The Faranah report describes an initial road-blocking group and another group entering town without establishing coordination or whether they were one action.
required_followup: Seek reporting on organizers, timing and coordination before treating the groups as a single gathering or separate events.

description: The body-read Faranah article reports mediation and a return to calm after about three hours, but not when the physical gatherings ended or whether electricity returned.
required_followup: Find follow-up evidence of the gathering’s physical end, service restoration, and any subsequent action.

description: A Kankan secondary-school boycott/resumption appears in January/February search-only leads, but exact action start, public assembly, duration and February activity are not established. No continuation is recorded because the onset date and episode are not verified.
required_followup: Review the underlying January and February reports if access permits, establish any public assembly and exact start/end dates, then coordinate with the January unit before assigning a month.

description: Kankan and Kamsar Orange Money agent-strike leads do not establish demands, public gatherings, attendance or a state-directed target. The exact Kankan URL open returned only Cache miss.
required_followup: Use separately available reporting if appropriate; keep both search-only and do not infer a state target or shared origin from subject similarity.

description: A search-only Boké lead describes transport disruption after a union official’s death amid a station-control dispute; no public gathering, turnout or state-directed demand is established.
required_followup: Review the exact article if access permits; determine whether this was a public assembly, an intra-union/private conflict, or another kind of event before coding.

description: Conakry demolition/eviction search leads cover distress, official justification, a school moratorium and political criticism, but do not establish a public protest gathering.
required_followup: Review the exact reports under the access protocol if later coverage warrants; determine whether residents assembled and whether a public demand was made.

description: A January 30 Fria bakery story and the opened February 12–16 account share a place and topic, but the January body was not read and no continuous episode is established.
required_followup: Review the January report and additional dated coverage before asserting continuity; do not merge solely by shared topic or locality.

description: The Q004 search response reported robots.txt blocking for its RFI-targeted query. No specific article body was requested, so this does not establish a publisher or article denial.
required_followup: Use ordinary separately indexed results for any relevant RFI coverage; retain this as a search-tool limitation and do not bypass restrictions.

description: The captured searches cover French and English terms, weekly windows, major cities and named regional leads/sectors, but the open-web first pass is not exhaustive and was not checked against LexisNexis or a complete official event baseline.
required_followup: A later coordinator review may compare against the permitted archival database and official baseline; preserve language, locality and source-access limits.

description: The Fria bakery stoppage is body-confirmed, but S015 gives no number of bakeries or workers and describes no public gathering; the 50-person threshold is unestablished. Its relation to the January search-only bakery lead is also unresolved.
required_followup: Find a count of participating bakers/workers or evidence of a qualifying gathering; review S016 for exact event dates and written origin before linking episodes.
